question.text: What is the 'Aggregate Escrow Demat Account' opened by an AIF used for?

answer.text: Parking uninvested fund corpus before drawdown
Holding demat units for existing investors who have not provided their demat account details
Holding sponsor commitment units before lock-in

explanation.text: The Logic: Per SFA implementation standards, this account holds demat units issued to existing investors who haven't provided their demat details; units move out within 5 working days once details are furnished. The Trap: Uninvested funds go to liquid mutual funds/treasuries; performance fees and sponsor commitment do not use this account. Cross-Exam Context: Unique to the AIF dematerialisation framework; no direct Mutual Fund analogue. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Collect demat details at onboarding itself to avoid parking in the escrow account, which creates operational friction.
